filterDomain: real ground-motion Hz, before the speed-up; audioBandHz is where it plays
note: A sped-up audio rendering of public seismic waveform data from one sensor's vertical channel. Gaps in the recording play as silence.

selection.rule: The bundle's hero event (meta.json scene.heroEventId); the nearest station of stationKind used in the run by epicentral distance (ties: station id order) whose source Nyquist is above the clip's band and whose vertical channel covers at least minCoverageFraction of the window; preS before and postS after the origin.

compression.description: Soft-knee downward compressor on a peak envelope: the peak of |x| over the next lookaheadMs, released exponentially (falls by 1/e per releaseMs), then averaged over the past lookaheadMs (audio ms). The envelope never falls below |x|, and the gain can start to fall at most lookaheadMs before the sample that drives it. Levels in dB relative to the levelPercentile of |x| over samples with data. Gain is (1/ratio - 1) x (level - thresholdDb) above the knee, quadratic inside it.
